answer: The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in dune, expire in grove, and mirror lists each expiry. An farming party running 112 aliases hence needs 19 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3465 identities would post 4874 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
